long_biography.plain_text:
Josef Haas was preparing for a promotion at Airbus in France when his father asked him to return to the family’s machinery business. He joined as a project engineer and moved into sales, drawing on practical experience gained during teenage summers in its workshop.

As head of sales, Haas travelled to customers and treated installation and after-sales performance as part of the equipment sale. The company audited production lines to improve efficiency long after delivery. Its technical centres offered baking trials and help with new recipes, including products using alternative flours.

Josef Haas was preparing for a promotion at Airbus in France when his father asked him to return to the family’s machinery business. He joined as a project engineer and moved into sales, drawing on practical experience gained during teenage summers in its workshop.

The company audited production lines to improve efficiency long after delivery. Its technical centres offered baking trials and help with new recipes, including products using alternative flours.
